title: Infraslow histaminergic dynamics govern priming states to gate moment-to-moment memory accessibility
title_zh: 次赫兹组胺能动态控制启动态，门控瞬时记忆可及性
abstract: Memory expression fluctuates even in response to identical cues, which suggests that ongoing brain states bias memory accessibility. However, the cellular and circuit principles governing these state-dependent fluctuations remain unclear. Here, we show that spontaneous pre-cue activity of histaminergic neurons in the hypothalamic tuberomammillary nucleus (TMN) modulates the expression of reward-associative memory in mice. TMN histaminergic activity exhibited infraslow dynamics (0.05-0.1 Hz) that closely tracked an integrated brain-body state. Closed-loop cue delivery during high histaminergic states enhanced memory expression. Brief optogenetic activation or inhibition of these neurons before the cue bidirectionally modulated memory expression, and direct activation of histaminergic terminals in the basolateral amygdala (BLA) was sufficient to enhance memory expression. Furthermore, histaminergic inhibition before the cue impaired the cue-evoked BLA population response. Thus, ongoing histaminergic activity exerts an infraslow, state-setting influence that primes BLA circuits for robust cue responses and, in turn, modulates moment-to-moment memory accessibility.
abstract_zh: 即便在相同线索条件下，记忆表达也会波动，说明持续脑状态会偏置记忆可及性。然而，主导这种状态依赖性波动的细胞和环路机制仍不明确。我们发现，视前核（TMN）组胺能神经元的线索前自发活动可调节小鼠奖赏联想记忆的表达。TMN组胺能活动表现出次赫兹动态（0.05–0.1 Hz），与整合性脑-体状态高度一致。在高组胺状态下进行闭环线索递呈可增强记忆表达。该神经元在线索出现前的短暂光遗传激活或抑制可双向调节记忆表达，且直接激活基底外侧杏仁核（BLA）中的组胺能终末即可增强记忆表达。此外，线索前组胺能抑制损害了线索诱发的BLA群体反应。因此，持续的组胺能活动以次赫兹节律设定状态，预置BLA回路以产生更强的线索反应，并从而调控记忆的瞬时可及性。
